# Capabilities (wave 1 + host)

| id | tier(s) | minSdk | summary | methods | permissions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `device.ui` | T1, T3 | 29 | Observe and act on other apps' UI through the best available provider (accessibility; shell as fallback). | `snapshot`, `find`, `wait_for`, `wait_for_settle`, `is_window_updating`, `dump`, `click`, `long_click`, `set_text`, `scroll_until`, `swipe`, `tap`, `press`, `hide_keyboard`, `keyboard_visible` | device.ui.observe, device.ui.act |
| `device.screenshot` | T1, T0, T3 | 29 | Capture the screen (fallback chain: accessibility API 30+ → MediaProjection → shell). | `capture` | device.screenshot |
| `device.app` | T0, T1, T3 | 29 | Query, launch and stop apps. | `query`, `list`, `foreground`, `wait_foreground`, `launch`, `stop` | device.app.query, device.app.launch, device.app.stop |
| `device.screen` | T0 | 29 | Screen/keyguard state (control methods arrive in W2). | `is_on`, `is_unlocked` | device.screen.read |
| `device.ime` | T0 | 29 | Reliable text entry and background clipboard through the AutoHost keyboard. | `commit_text`, `clipboard_get`, `clipboard_set` | device.ime |
| `notify.post` | T0 | 29 | Post a notification (with actions/progress). | `post` | notify.post |
| `ui.prompt` | T0 | 29 | Ask the user something while a run waits (WAITING_USER). | `ask`, `toast` | ui.prompt |
| `files.private` | T0 | 29 | Task-private storage. | `read`, `write`, `list`, `delete` | files.private |
| `net.http` | T0 | 29 | Brokered HTTP with domain allowlist and size caps. | `request` | net.http |
| `store` | host | 29 | Persistent key-value stores (profile- and task-scoped). Non-secret values only. | `get`, `set`, `delete`, `list` | store.profile, store.task |
| `secrets` | host | 29 | Read declared secret fields of the active profile (host injects at call time). | `get` | secrets.read |
| `state` | host | 29 | Checkpoints and stage records owned by the host. | `get`, `set`, `stage_begin`, `stage_end` | state.checkpoint |
| `device.notifications` | T0 | 29 | Read, react to, press and dismiss other apps' notifications through the notification listener. | `list`, `read`, `press`, `dismiss`, `dismiss_all`, `wait_for` | device.notifications |
| `device.clipboard` | T0 | 29 | Read (focus-gated) and set the system clipboard; background reads go through the IME. | `get`, `set` | device.clipboard |
| `device.intent` | T0 | 29 | Start activities and broadcasts behind an allowlist carried by the grant. | `open_url`, `open_settings`, `start_activity`, `broadcast` | device.intent |
| `device.events` | T0 | 29 | Read-side window into the host EventHub ring buffer; reactive use is via trigger rules. | `recent` | device.events |
| `files.shared` | T0 | 29 | User-picked folders (SAF) and MediaStore reads/writes. Trees must be granted; media ops need the media scope flag plus the storage permission (lazy). | `list`, `read`, `write`, `delete`, `media_list`, `media_read`, `media_write`, `media_delete` | files.shared |
| `net.ws` | T0 | 29 | Outbound WebSocket client (RFC 6455) with size/time caps and the net.http domain allowlist. | `connect`, `send`, `recv`, `close` | net.ws |
| `net.server` | T0 | 29 | Local webhook endpoint: POST /hook/<name> fires the matching `external` trigger. Localhost by default; LAN opt-in with token. | `status`, `hook_names` | net.server |
| `device.audio` | T0 | 29 | Volume, ringer, DND status (honest), TTS, vibrate, flashlight. DND changes need policy access (setup action). | `volume`, `ringer`, `dnd`, `speak`, `vibrate`, `flashlight`, `play_sound` | device.audio |
| `device.power` | T0 | 29 | Battery/charging state, task-scoped wake lock and keep-awake. Never changes device-level battery settings. | `battery`, `wake_lock`, `keep_awake` | device.power |
| `ui.overlay` | T1 | 29 | Floating overlays a run can draw: highlight boxes, text panels, status strips. Visible and stoppable; needs the accessibility overlay. | `highlight`, `panel`, `clear` | ui.overlay |
| `device.settings` | T0, T3 | 29 | Read system/secure/global settings tables; write via the one-time WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS grant or the paired shell tier (W4, gated). | `read`, `read_many`, `write` | device.settings.read, device.settings.write |
| `schedule.self` | host | 29 | Script-proposed next-run adjustments within declared bounds (ctx.next_run). Proposals are user-visible and clamped. |  | schedule.self |
| `tasks.run` | host | 29 | Start another task/profile and await its result (chaining). Depth/cycle limited; counts toward locks. | `run` | tasks.run |
| `android.api.direct` | T2 | 29 | Raw Android API access from Python (Chaquopy jclass / system services). Breaks the sandbox by design; needs the android.api.direct grant AND the raw_api switch. | `authorize` | android.api.direct |
| `device.shell` | T3 | 29 | Run allowlisted shell commands through the paired shell tier (ADB-over-TCP, wireless debugging, Shizuku or root). DANGEROUS; allowlist default empty; needs the device.shell grant AND the shell switch. | `run`, `transports` | device.shell |
| `device.app.manage` | T3 | 29 | Install/uninstall APK, clear app data, grant/revoke runtime permissions, verified force-stop. T3 shell tier; DANGEROUS; needs the device.app.manage grant AND the app_manage switch. Destructive methods demand confirm:true. | `force_stop`, `clear_state`, `grant_permission`, `revoke_permission`, `install`, `uninstall` | device.app.manage |
| `device.logcat` | T3 | 29 | Snapshot/clear the logcat main buffer for evidence. T3 shell tier; dev-grade; needs the device.logcat grant AND the logcat switch. A package filter resolves the app's pid via pidof — no package claims without it. | `snapshot`, `clear` | device.logcat |
| `device.radio` | T3 | 29 | Wi-Fi / Bluetooth / airplane / mobile-data toggles through the shell tier (`svc`, settings + broadcast). T3 only — Wi-Fi toggling is blocked for normal apps since API 29; Bluetooth toggling works only up to API 32. Acts report the exit code honestly; no readback claim (verified:false). | `set` | device.radio |
| `device.display` | T3 | 29 | Dark mode, orientation and font scale through the shell tier (`cmd uimode night`, `settings put`). T3. | `set_dark_mode`, `set_orientation`, `set_font_scale` | device.display |
| `device.location.mock` | T3 | 29 | The mock-location appop for AutoHost itself (DANGEROUS; needs the device.location.mock grant AND the mock_location switch). Verified against `appops get` — the readback is real. | `set` | device.location.mock |
| `browser.webview` | T0 | 29 | Automate pages in a visible in-app WebView (Playwright-like subset): open/navigate/click/type/extract/cookies. Real input events where the WebView allows; challenges are detected and routed to WAITING_USER — never bypassed. Per-profile cookie isolation (S26). | `open`, `navigate`, `click`, `type`, `extract`, `cookies`, `clear_cookies`, `pages`, `close` | browser.open, browser.read |
| `browser.a11y` | T1 | 29 | Drive the user's own browser app through the accessibility layer: open (VIEW intent + foreground wait), click by visible text, type into the focused field, extract the visible text. No cookies, no CSS — the DOM is not exposed; those limits are enforced, not worked around. | `open`, `click`, `type`, `extract`, `page`, `close` | browser.open, browser.read |
| `browser.cdp` | T3 | 29 | Chrome DevTools Protocol over the paired shell tier: `adb forward tcp:<p> localabstract:<socket>` through the shell transport, then a local WebSocket to the devtools endpoint. DRAFT — UNVERIFIED-on-hardware until spike S27 measures the route. Needs the shell tier. | `status`, `navigate`, `evaluate`, `screenshot`, `cookies`, `close` | browser.open, browser.read |
| `vision` | T4 | 29 | OCR, template match and QR decode over a screenshot region or a run-scoped image. Tier T4 contract on the wire: every result carries hint:true — hints, not proof. OCR text is never auto-evidenced (may contain secrets). | `ocr`, `template_match`, `qr_decode` | vision.read |
| `contacts` | T0 | 29 | Query and insert contacts (row-capped, name/phone/email fields). Lazy runtime permissions via the FixHub ask. | `query`, `insert` | contacts.read, contacts.write |
| `calendar` | T0 | 29 | Query and insert calendar events in a bounded window (31 days max). Lazy runtime permissions. | `query`, `insert` | calendar.read, calendar.write |
| `media` | T0 | 29 | Device-wide MediaStore rows (images/video/audio) — distinct from files.shared's user-picked-tree media ops. Byte-capped reads/inserts. | `list`, `read`, `insert`, `delete` | media, media.write |
| `location` | T0 | 29 | One-shot location fixes (last-known marked stale; current waits up to 60 s). Background runs need 'Allow all the time' — honestly reported, never silently downgraded. | `last_known`, `current` | location |
| `camera` | T0 | 29 | One-shot photo capture (front or back camera) into a run-scoped file. No preview, no stealth — the shutter is visible. | `capture_photo` | camera |
| `microphone` | T0 | 29 | Duration-capped audio recording (max 60 s, default 10 s) into a run-scoped file. The recording indicator stays on. | `record` | microphone |
| `sensors` | T0 | 29 | One-shot sensor reads (no permission, no continuous streams). list = what the device has; read = latest sample per sensor (bounded set). | `list`, `read` | sensors |
| `device.sms` | T0 | 29 | Read the inbox (sender-scoped by the grant), send with premium/short-code rails and a per-run budget, wait_for a matching message. DANGEROUS; full flavor only; needs the device.sms grant AND the sms switch. Delivery receipts are never claimed. | `read_inbox`, `send`, `wait_for` | device.sms.read, device.sms.send |
| `device.telephony` | T0 | 29 | Call state read and dialer-owned calls (ACTION_CALL — the user sees and can cancel the dialer). DANGEROUS; full flavor only; needs the grant AND the telephony switch; premium/short-code rails like device.sms. | `call_state`, `place_call` | device.telephony.read, device.telephony.place_call |
| `net.socket` | T0 | 29 | Raw TCP client + one-shot UDP send/recv with the net.http-style domain allowlist, byte caps and run-scoped handles. Tasks initiate; listeners stay net.server's job. | `tcp_connect`, `tcp_send`, `tcp_recv`, `tcp_close`, `udp_send`, `udp_recv` | net.socket |
| `net.reverse` | T0 | 29 | The device dials OUT to a control/reporting host (plan 6.5): nothing listens on the device. Token rides the first frame (never the URL); plain ws:// only for localhost, wss:// otherwise. Off by default: needs the net.reverse grant AND the net_reverse switch. | `open`, `send`, `recv`, `close` | net.reverse |
